Do not submit personal data, identifiable conversations, credentials, keys, raw Context, internal tickets or runtime audits. Sensitive concerns follow SECURITY.md; these public issues are not a confidential channel.

Identify actor, asset, trust boundary, attack preconditions and unverified mitigation.

## Limits and privacy check
